prior_summary: Clearance waypoint hierarchy: a causal full-state encoder predicts event and manipulated-entity probabilities and conditions a learned spatial waypoint diffusion denoiser. A separate conditional action DDPM consumes the resulting robot/object intent and current state. Local future waypoints, event changes, capped duration and ongoing motion are supervised; teacher and predicted intents are mixed during action training.
applicable_conditions: The complete assigned expanded evacuation slices, including a moving drawer handle at entry, release and retreat, red approach/grasp/lift/transport/place, and red release/retreat followed by blue acquisition and initial lift. Supported by similar drawer/pad geometry and one ordered route; use world-frame poses, finger positions, object-to-TCP relations and causal motion to identify unfinished prerequisites.
termination_guidance: Do not terminate merely because red is horizontally over the pad. Continue descending and releasing when appropriate, or transfer within the shared placement-to-blue-lift chain to a successor that can finish those prerequisites. A useful late exit has red resting near z=0.020 m, drawer near 0.297 m open and blue moving with TCP during initial lift, not a forced stop at a high waypoint. The global success contract alone determines task completion and does not require release, clearance or a hold.
limitations: Training exposes only 15 genuinely future states beyond the current state, so waypoint targets are next observed semantic changes or censored local progress, not full distant transition endpoints. Event/contact labels are geometric proxies. The auxiliary waypoint denoiser uses a five-step deterministic central DDIM estimate, while actions retain the fixed 100-step stochastic DDPM. No persistent event-aware high-level cache, IK, collision certification, image encoder, joint-action equivariance or established failure recovery is implemented.

config.segmentation: All 12 assigned expanded slices, unchanged; starts at 195 and retains each assigned trajectory-specific stop.
config.normalization: Shared complete-demonstration limits normalizer; relative xyz scales are the elementwise maximum of its TCP, red and blue xyz half-ranges. No refitting.

architecture.temporal_features: previous frame, current frame, four times their difference
architecture.auxiliary_denoiser: 256-wide residual MLP, three blocks, continuous log-SNR encoding and epsilon prediction
architecture.auxiliary_inference: Five deterministic DDIM updates from a zero central latent; predicted clean waypoint components numerically clamped to [-5,5].
architecture.action_decoder: DiffusionBackbone with fixed U-Net widths 128/256/512, kernel 5, groups 8 and timestep embedding 128

training.selection: last EMA at the predeclared budget
